examples.label: Newsletter signup with an email field and subscribe button
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h5" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold">Get the monthly changelog <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 text-zinc-600">One email a month with everything we shipped. No sales, ever.
<.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="newsletter-email" name="email" value="" type="email" label="Email address" />
<.component component_name="chelekom-input-button" site="Global" id="newsletter-submit" type="submit" value="Subscribe" variant="default" color="primary" size="small" />

examples.label: Project enquiry form with message and consent checkbox
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">Tell us about your project <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="enquiry-name" name="name" value="" type="text" label="Full name" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="enquiry-email" name="email" value="" type="email" label="Work email" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="enquiry-message" name="message" value="" type="textarea" label="What do you need built?" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="enquiry-terms" name="terms" value="" type="checkbox" label="I agree to the privacy policy" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input-button" site="Global" id="enquiry-submit" type="submit" value="Send message" variant="default" color="primary" full_width={true} />

examples.label: Workspace settings with a plan select and a rejected value
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h5" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold">Workspace settings <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="workspace-name" name="workspace" value="Studio Karimi" type="text" label="Workspace name" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="workspace-plan" name="plan" type="select" value="team" label="Plan" options={[{"Starter", "starter"}, {"Team", "team"}, {"Business", "business"}]} /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="workspace-slug" name="slug" value="studio karimi" type="text" label="Workspace URL" errors={["can only contain letters, numbers and dashes"]} />

examples.label: Sign-in card with email, password and remember me
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold" class="text-center">Welcome back <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="signin-email" name="email" value="" type="email" label="Email" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="signin-password" name="password" value="" type="password" label="Password" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input" site="Global" id="signin-remember" name="remember" value="" type="checkbox" label="Keep me signed in" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-input-button" site="Global" id="signin-submit" type="submit" value="Sign in" variant="default" color="primary" full_width={true} />
